exposure: Internal cervical os being open before cervical ripening
Cervical ripening method (dinoprostone insert, cervical ripening balloon, oral misoprostol, repeated methods)
Cervical ripening using a dinoprostone insert (PG)
cohort: 146 women with GDM at term who underwent cervical ripening
finding: Vaginal delivery rate was similar across different cervical ripening methods, but internal cervical os being open before ripening predicted vaginal delivery, while previous cesarean delivery and higher birthweight predicted cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that the rate of vaginal delivery did not differ significantly between different methods of cervical ripening in women with gestational diabetes mellitus at term.
